headline: Arsenal's Ezri Konsa 'loved' battle with England teammate Morgan Rogers in Chelsea clash
description: Ezri Konsa was delighted with his tackle on former teammate Morgan Rogers that brought a roar of approval from Arsenal fans during Sunday's 2-1 win over Chelsea.

headline: Transfer rumors, news: Chelsea eye Scott to replace Enzo Fernández
description: Chelsea are at the front of the queue to sign AFC Bournemouth midfielder Alex Scott. Transfer Talk has the latest.

headline: Arsenal show Chelsea, Premier League who's boss; Inter the team to beat in Serie A
description: Arsenal looked rattled against Chelsea thanks to an early goal, but Mikel Arteta's side quickly showed why it's the team to beat in England. Plus Inter prove they are Serie A's top team, as Gab Marcotti recaps the weekend.

headline: Benjamin Šeško urges Man United to find positives after 'painful' Everton draw
description: Benjamin Sesko has said Manchester United must try to take positives from the "painful" last-gasp draw at Everton and reset ahead of their long-awaited Champions League return.

headline: Man United still pursuing Leicester midfielder Louis Page - sources
description: Manchester United are still in the hunt for Louis Page despite missing out on a deadline day move for the Leicester City midfielder, sources have told ESPN.

headline: Wayne Rooney: Arsenal defender Gabriel 'extremely lucky' to avoid red in Chelsea win
description: Wayne Rooney has said Arsenal defender Gabriel was "extremely lucky" to avoid being sent off in his side's 2-1 win over Chelsea on Sunday.
